slice: Work Hub comms receipt bridge polish
intent: Make built-in Messenger, Mail, and Community feel like one dogfooded FD-001 tenant workload by adding a visible bridge from communications actions into Workflow, Oyatie Cloud, and the universal receipt stream, with local-only draft/seal actions.
product_direction: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Added a Comms Receipt Bridge inside Work Hub so Messenger ops room, Mail approval brief, Community council note, and Audit receipt are visible as one local FD-001 communications proof packet.
Added selectable bridge route cards with route title, receipt id, route target, detail panel, and local status updates using the existing dense command-surface visual language.

Added local bridge actions for Workflow, Oyatie Cloud, Audit receipt, Draft all, and Seal handoff; Audit selects the comms receipt in the Receipt Stitching Console and Draft all inserts a Work Hub handoff draft.
Synchronized bridge selections/actions with Work Hub tabs, Comms route status, Oyatie Cloud substrate proof strip, Product Activity Spine, activity feed, and universal audit receipt stream.
Added responsive CSS for desktop/tablet/mobile with no horizontal overflow while preserving the Bominal-style dense operator console feel.

before_metrics.issue: Work Hub already had Messenger/Mail/Community boards and a handoff bus, but the three built-in communications surfaces still needed a stronger visible bridge back to universal receipts and Oyatie Cloud dogfood workload proof.

visual_ralph_verdict.category_match: Built-in Messenger/Mail/Community command workspace integrated with FD-001/Oyatie Cloud proof stream
differences: Reference Bominal is a standalone local app; Oyatie intentionally keeps Work Hub, product activity, cloud substrate proof, and receipt stitching language visible together.
Communication sends/posts are local draft/seal previews rather than real external delivery by requirement.
suggestions: A future typed Leptos state unification can collapse the fallback JS comms model into a single Work Hub state machine.
Next visual slice can add keyboard shortcuts and side-panel focus trapping for operator-grade Work Hub accessibility polish.
Finance, Identity, Intelligence, and People Ops can emit the same comms receipt bridge packets into the universal receipt stream.
visual_ralph_verdict.reasoning: The new bridge makes built-in Messenger, Mail, and Community feel like one cohesive product surface rather than separate widgets. Browser QA proves route selection, draft handoff insertion, audit receipt selection, seal control, and responsive no-overflow behavior across 1440, 1024, and 390 widths.

verification.summary: desktop/tablet/mobile bridge visible, Mail route, Draft all handoff, Audit receipt route, Seal action, no console errors, no horizontal overflow

local_only_boundary: No workflow execution, mail send, community publish, backend write, audit vault write, deploy, DNS, billing, IAM, or cloud-provider mutation is wired; all Work Hub comms receipt bridge actions are browser visual state.
